    Kupisch: corners are one-sided cyclic #

    Assume the chain condition of Jans (ChainX). For g ∈ M = e_jRe_i outside R², either every element of M is a left multiple of g or every element is a right multiple (one_sided; Kupisch, J. reine angew. Math. 201 (1959), Satz 1.1). Moreover M ⊆ k g + R² (mem_span_sq).
